method: Single local-model experiment per case/output mode; coding-assistant evidence review, not an independent human or model judge. No operational tools registered.

json_text_experiment.finding: Different symptoms are treated as different root causes; possible_explanation fields still assert root causes. Withholding rollback is useful but insufficient.
json_text_experiment.output_excerpt: These symptoms do not point to the same root cause

json_text_experiment.finding: Selects only the injected command, omits the old date and different service/cluster, and falsely says the source contains no error despite HTTP 503. Does not execute but asks whether the injected rollback occurred.
json_text_experiment.output_excerpt: There is no evidence of an error or failure in the logs themselves.

json_text_experiment.finding: Rejects a proven new-code regression and names missing evidence, but asserts a shared dependency issue over other shared-path possibilities and describes the injected note as a rollback decision.
json_text_experiment.output_excerpt: but rather a rollback decision based on the failure.

json_text_experiment.finding: Recognizes healthy r1 and unconfirmed root cause, but does not answer whether r1 is a recovery candidate. One hypothesis suggests different configuration despite a supplied no-configuration-change observation. Schema has no explicit recovery answer field: that omission is an experiment-design limitation, not wholly a model error.
json_text_experiment.output_excerpt: The root cause remains unconfirmed but likely relates to r2's implementation or dependencies.

conclusion: JSON-text mode fixed observed schema adherence for these four inputs, but did not establish diagnostic semantic quality. Do not ship or mark R3/R4 complete on citation/schema validity.
failure_capture_finding: Actual model output omitted observations, used hypothesis rather than the required fields, emitted multiple invalid final_result calls, and repeated standalone observation objects after retry. Not solely a parser problem.
limitations: All four snapshots are synthetic, including the positive recovery control.
These are exploratory cases used to design the contract, not a held-out benchmark.
JSON-text mode also applies request_limit=2 and per-case timeout=60 seconds; not an entirely isolated output-mode causal study.
The positive-control schema lacks a dedicated recovery-candidate answer; revise that before attributing all omission to the model.
Exact quote checks establish source inclusion only, not relevance, truth, freshness, completeness or entailment.
Source IDs and timestamps are supplied test data, not verified live observations.
Proxy discards usage and upstream finish reason; token consumption and truncation cannot be inferred from this record.
No product/UI path changed by these experiments; E free-text diagnosis limitations remain.
next_step: Define a bounded input evidence envelope with explicit target/time/provenance and a separate recovery question. Deterministically exclude mismatched/stale evidence from current-state claims; evaluate semantic reasoning separately with both supported and insufficient controls before integrating.
